info.title: Rental Platform API
info.description: Backend for the multi-tenant rental platform. Errors are always `{ error: { code, message, issues? } }`. Money is integer IDR. Timestamps are ISO-8601 with timezone.

servers.description: Same origin (via rewrite) or the deployed API host

tags.name: Admin
tags.description: Tenant-scoped management for owners and staff

cookieAuth.name: rt_access
cookieAuth.description: Access token cookie set by /v1/auth/login. The admin app reaches this API via a same-origin rewrite.

webKey.name: x-web-key
webKey.description: Shared secret used by rental-web server-side calls.
